title: Compatible principal-open section equivalences from homogeneous-chart localization comparisons
statement: Let $S$ be an $\mathbb N$-graded commutative ring with grading $\mathcal A$, let $M$ be an $S$-module, and set $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Index charts by pairs $f=(a,d)$ with $d>0$ and $a\in S_d$. Put $D_f=D_+(a)$, $R_f=S_{(a)}$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], $N_f=M_a$, and let $Z_f\subseteq N_f$ be $R_f$-submodules, where the scalar action on $N_f$ is restricted from $S_a$. For each inclusion $D_g\subseteq D_f$, suppose ring maps $\rho^S_{f,g}:R_f\to R_g$ and additive maps $\rho_{f,g}:Z_f\to Z_g$ are given. Let $U_{f,g}\in R_f$ have image $g^{\deg f}/f^{\deg g}$ in $S_f$. Suppose additive equivalences $\theta_{f,g}:(Z_f)_{U_{f,g}}\cong Z_g$ and ring equivalences $\theta^S_{f,g}:(R_f)_{U_{f,g}}\cong R_g$ are given for all these inclusions, with $\theta_{f,g}(q/1)=\rho_{f,g}(q)$, $\theta^S_{f,g}(r/1)=\rho^S_{f,g}(r)$ and $\theta_{f,g}(tq)=\theta^S_{f,g}(t)\theta_{f,g}(q)$. Assume every $\rho^S_{f,g}$ is induced by an $S$-algebra map $S_f\to S_g$. Let $F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with additive equivalences $\alpha_f:F(D_f)\cong Z_f$, compatible with scalar multiplication via awayToSection and with restriction via $\rho$. Fix $f$, let $e_f:D_f\cong\operatorname{Spec}R_f$ be the canonical chart isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-proj-basic-open-intersection], and set $E=F|_{D_f}$ and $G=e_f^*(\widetilde{Z_f})$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], using restriction along the open immersion $e_f$. For the set $B=\{e_f^{-1}(D(r)):r\in R_f\}$ of principal chart opens, there are $\mathcal O_{D_f}(U)$-linear equivalences $l_U:E(U)\cong G(U)$ for all $U\in B$, and $l_V(s|_V)=l_U(s)|_V$ for every inclusion $V\subseteq U$ in $B$ and every $s\in E(U)$. No global sheaf morphism or isomorphism is asserted.
